Feedback.// DbPath: Path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to <ContentRoot>/feedback.db if unset.
Feedback.// RateLimitKey: Secret key used to derive the one-way, per-caller/per-release HMAC that enforces the AC-8 submission cap (see RateLimitKeyProvider). REQUIRED in production: if left unset, a random key is generated at process startup and a warning is logged - the cap silently resets on every restart. Set via an environment variable or secret store, never commit a real value here.
Feedback.// SubmissionLimitPerRelease: Max stored submissions per caller per release before 429/submission_limit_reached (AC-8). Must be >= 1.
Feedback.// RetentionMonths: Records received more than this many months ago are permanently purged (AC-10). Must be >= 1.
Feedback.// BusyTimeoutMilliseconds: How long a write waits for the SQLite write lock before failing with 503/storage_busy.
